_comment: Grafana datasource provisioning for Confluent Cloud Metrics API. Place in /etc/grafana/provisioning/datasources/ or configure via Grafana UI.

_setup_instructions.step_1: Obtain a CC Metrics API key from Confluent Cloud console: Cloud environment > API keys > Add key > Select 'Cloud resource management' scope
_setup_instructions.step_2: Replace {{CC_METRICS_API_KEY}} and {{CC_METRICS_API_SECRET}} with your actual credentials
_setup_instructions.step_3: Replace {{CLUSTER_ID}} with your Kafka cluster ID (e.g., lkc-xxxxx)
_setup_instructions.step_4: For multiple clusters, create one datasource per cluster with a unique name (e.g., 'CC Metrics - East', 'CC Metrics - West')

_prometheus_export_format: The CC Metrics API Prometheus export endpoint returns metrics in Prometheus exposition format. Grafana's built-in Prometheus datasource can scrape it directly with basic auth.
